title: Skill Forage
wikitext:
This skill enables you to find food and water. These items stay with you even after logging out. The higher the skill the more regularly you will succeed in your attempts. You can attempt the skill forage every minute.

== Who Gets The Skill ==

* Any [[Iksar]] at level 1, fixed at 50.
* [[Bard]]s at level 12, max of 55.
* [[Druid]]s at level 5, max of 200. (skill is level-capped at (Level*5)+5)
* [[Ranger]]s at level 3, max of 200.
* [[Shaman]]s at level 16, max of 50.
* [[Wood Elf|Wood Elves]] at level 1, fixed at 50.

== Zone-Specific Foraging ==

Items on  the "All Norrath" table can be foraged in any zone by any person with the forage skill. However, druids and rangers with a forage skill of over 100 or anyone with a racial foraging ability can often find that various zones will produce a few extra surprises: many of which can be sold for money; some of which are used in quests; and some of which can be used for brewing, baking, or cultural smithing.

== Chat Log Messages ==

* SUCCESS (Food) = You have scrounged up some food.
* SUCCESS (Drink) = You have scrounged up some water.
* SUCCESS (Bait) = You have scrounged up some fishing grubs.
* SUCCESS (Other) = You have scrounged up something that doesn't look edible.
* FAILURE = You fail to locate any food nearby.
